stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Lead Nail Tech
stylists.bio: Founder of Rich Cheap Chick Enterprise, built on one belief: every woman deserves to look and feel rich — without breaking the bank. Expect flawless sets, fun custom art, and a whole lot of pink.

reviews.name: Tasha M.
reviews.text: My pink bow set is everything! So clean, so cute, and the price was unbeatable. I'm never going anywhere else.

reviews.name: Brittany J.
reviews.text: She took my Pinterest picture and made it even better. My nails lasted over three weeks with no lifting.

reviews.name: Keondra W.
reviews.text: Rich look, cheap price — they really mean it. Friendly vibe and my pedicure was so relaxing.

reviews.name: Alicia R.
reviews.text: Best nail tech in Southaven, hands down. Always on time and the nail art is so detailed.
